acceptanceCriteria: QUESTPIE v4 removes the framework-owned Channel concept completely: no Channel Resource, defineChannel, generated Channel client or codecs, PostgreSQL Channel ledger/order/replay/generation, Channel presence model, or runtime.channelCarrier remains current or deferred product scope.
The removal introduces no replacement Signal, Broadcast, Presence, event-bus Resource, provider registry, runtime provider binding, or generic semantic adapter contract.

Live Query remains the sole built-in continuing client-state mechanism: Query.watch recomputes current authorized state from PostgreSQL Change Ledger facts, while durable application history remains an ordinary Collection queried through Policy.

Reaction and Job retain durable acceptance and attempt ownership. A post-commit provider publish crosses an Action or external-effect Service boundary, remains physically at least once, and retains ambiguity when the provider offers no idempotency or reliable receipt lookup; no exactly-once provider delivery claim is introduced.

Transient delivery, provider subscription authentication, connection lifetime, rate limits, advisory presence, and provider observability are application/provider concerns. They cannot authorize QUESTPIE Operations or become durable application truth.

The collaboration fixture's Company -> Space -> Channel -> Membership -> Message graph and ordinary channels Collection remain intact; the removed capitalized concept is the framework capability only.

ADR-0017, ADR-0019, ADR-0021, and the P14 conformance requirement are superseded only for Channel. Their accepted proof heads, manifests, review records, and v3 evidence remain immutable historical evidence rather than being rewritten.

The repository-aware scan enumerates root authority, every ADR, top-level v4 product document, public v4 guide, design-fiction source, visual, the permanent capability map, and current wayfinders. A broad case-insensitive Channel word boundary finds every occurrence; each path is either in the exact authority projection or an exact justified benign domain/English exemption whose bytes contain no core-capability marker.

Accepted proof artifacts retain claims reviewed at their pinned heads, while permanent maps and current ADR, product, gate, build, public-documentation, visual, and wayfinder surfaces project the new decision. P15 SLICE.json, P16 QUEUE.json, P14 Channel evidence, and research evidence are explicitly classified and superseded without rewriting them.

This proof changes only the candidate decision, structured projection, validator, negative controls, manifest, and recorded initial review. It does not project authority before PASS and changes no production code, fixture, public docs, or pre-existing historical evidence.
